title: The flat program of symbolic user functions and expressions as a Python structure, GetFlatProgram of expressions and flatten
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.50.2: GetFlatProgramData() of a UserFunction and esym.GetFlatProgramData(expressions, arguments, resultNames): the operations of the flat program as a list, entry k = node k, operands by number; esym.GetFlatProgram(expressions, ...) and flatten=True/False; an operation name per expression class; the writer of the format 'Python' in exudyn/misc/symbolicExport.py, equal to the text of C++.
releaseNotes: GetFlatProgramData() of a symbolic UserFunction and exudyn.symbolic.GetFlatProgramData(expressions, arguments, resultNames) give the flat program as a Python structure: arguments, operations (entry k is the tK of the text, its operands by number) and results. exudyn.symbolic.GetFlatProgram(expressions, ...) writes the flat program of expressions; flatten=False writes each result as one expression.
